verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents running agents on demand (Runner.run, run_sync, run_streamed), sessions, tracing, and human-in-the-loop resume. Nothing shows a built-in way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The community mention of a Temporal-based durable version describes an external orchestration tool, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. A one-off run is not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
